def parse_display(lines,box):
    x0,y0,x1,y1=box
    require(len(lines)==x1-x0,'display column count')
    values={}
    for pos,line in enumerate(lines):
        lead,body=line.split(':',1)
        require(lead==str(x0+pos),'display column order')
        x=int(lead);previous=y0-1
        for token in body.split():
            row,rgb=token.split(':',1)
            require(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+',row) is not None,'row integer')
            y=int(row)
            require(y0<=y<y1 and y>previous,'display row order/range')
            previous=y
            channels=rgb.split(',')
            require(len(channels)==3 and all(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+',n) for n in channels),'RGB arity')
            value=tuple(int(n) for n in channels)
            require(all(0<=n<=255 for n in value),'RGB range')
            require(value!=(255,255,255),'no explicit exact-white')
            values[x,y]=value
    return values
fixture=['1: 1:255,254,255','2: 0:0,4,7']

    require(a['context_boxes'][pair]==derived,'clipped 2-cell box '+pair)
    x0,y0,x1,y1=derived
    rows=a['cells'][pair]

    expected_pixels={}
    white=nearwhite=0

        x=x0+index%(x1-x0); y=y0+index//(x1-x0)
        require(set(row)=={'x','y','rgb'},'cell keys')
        require(type(row['x']) is int and type(row['y']) is int and row['x']==x and row['y']==y,'row-major exact coordinates')
        require(type(row['rgb']) is list and len(row['rgb'])==3 and all(type(v) is int and 0<=v<=255 for v in row['rgb']),'integer RGB')
        off=3*(y*w+x);value=tuple(pixels[off:off+3])
